subject: strategy
text:
- The accessibility tree is built from the document on InitialTreeRequested and refreshed on change: on a poll that reported work the shell's `View::poll` takes the document's changed set (`BaseDocument::take_changed_nodes` — outside the `accessibility` cfg, so a shell built without the feature still drains it) and, under `accessibility`, rebuilds the platform tree when the set it took was non-empty; both paths go through the `Document::accessibility_tree` trait method, so a wrapper's override (DioxusDocument's stable ids) reaches the platform tree (packages/blitz-shell/src/application.rs:77-83; packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:377-383; packages/blitz-shell/src/window.rs:522-525; packages/blitz-shell/src/accessibility.rs:44-46; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:191-199). Before 2026-10-07-change-tracking-and-diff the poll-time refresh did not run — the flag the poll read, `has_changes()`, read false after an in-document write on a document nothing had drained, and nothing drained the set — so the platform tree was built once (as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-change-tracking-and-diff/evidence/control-changed-set.txt). The refresh on change is ratified by the founder (2026-10-07) — one item with the engine's changed-set contract in the next bullet.
 Its windowed witness is still owed: no windowed run witnesses the refresh on the dev host — its AT-SPI bus reads inactive, and the stand's windowed binary builds blitz-shell without `accessibility` — so it is proven at the document level (the `changed_set_` unit tests) and by both feature builds of blitz-shell — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-change-tracking-and-diff/report.md; since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions both halves are proven headlessly on the stand, in both layout modes: on Counter, after a drained changed set, each Tab of the whole `tab_order` leaves `has_changes()` true and the focus of the tree read through `&dyn Document` — the tree the shell hands the adapter — reads the new stop, and Enter on the focused `counter-increment` then leaves `has_changes()` true and `counter-value`'s name reads `0` → `1` in that tree (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_accessibility_ids.rs:363-410 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions/report.md); its windowed witness, at the platform adapter, is still owed — the stand builds no adapter, kept so on the founder's F1 «Пока нет, перенести (Рекомендую)» (2026-10-14, by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed by the overseer as his chosen option label) — and is owned by a `.andromeda/residuals.md` line that reads `re-carried:0.2.0`, the witness at an active assistive technology, which this version does not reach

subject: strategy
text: - `changed_nodes` is the engine's changed set, the nodes written since the last `take_changed_nodes`: a mutation of an in-document node, a focus or checked change, a text control's input and a select's changed choice mark it — `apply_select_choice` marking nothing for a choice of the chosen option (packages/blitz-dom/src/events/keyboard.rs:470-496); node creation, hover, active, scroll and layout do not; `has_changes()` reads true while it is non-empty. So a focus move, a checked change and a rewritten accessible name each reach the refresh above, and a pointer move alone does not (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:371-374; packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:1485-1498) — ratified by the founder (2026-10-07), the same item — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-change-tracking-and-diff/report.md. A harness settle (`Harness::settle`, the driver session's `act`) neither reads nor drains the set, so a step settled through it leaves the refresh above, and a later diff, exactly what the step marked; and the set is non-empty on a freshly booted harness document — the boot's own in-document mutations mark it and nothing has drained it — so a check that reads `has_changes()` as "this step changed something" drains first (packages/blitz-test-harness/src/settle.rs:129-191; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_settle.rs:78-119; as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-07-settle-detection/report.md and its evidence/red-first.md)

subject: strategy
text:
- Since 2026-10-17-upstream-sync-engine-debts the builder also holds upstream's six reads, as upstream wrote them (merged at `23b9b26a9`, merge `3eda07bc`): `aria-labelledby` — after the `<label>` → input loop it clears `labelled_by`, pushes the referenced nodes and sets their computed text as the `label`, so it outranks a `<label>` and an `aria-label` (accname 2B), an id that names no built node ignored, a self-reference and nested text included, hidden targets read for the label without being referenced, the `aria-label` the fallback when the targets hold no text; `aria-describedby` (the referenced nodes as `described_by`); `aria-description` (its own text into AccessKit's description field); `aria-expanded` (a boolean); `aria-disabled` (`true` → `set_disabled`); `aria-level` (a number, with the tag and role defaults); then `set_html_tag` last; the trimmed non-empty `aria-label` read and the three closed-set state reads above are kept, upstream's own `parse::<bool>` `aria-selected` and unfiltered `aria-label` reads dropped in the merge, so there is still one read per attribute; the snapshot reads no description and its `enabled` reads the `disabled` attribute, so `aria-disabled` moves no snapshot reading; no stand file states any of the six; the description and the three new closed values leave only to the platform adapter, which no stand binary builds (§1), so what an assistive technology reads of them is not measured; `aria-labelledby` names inside the ratified name crossing and the description to the adapter ratified as upstream's behaviour by the founder (2026-10-17, by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed by the overseer, «Утвердить оба (Рекомендую)»; both description sources confirmed by his «Подтвердить все 10 (Рекомендую)», 2026-10-18) (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:42-47; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:62-103;
 packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:126-133; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:237-268; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:303-354; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:444-465; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_label.rs:30-297; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_description.rs:8-93) — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-17-upstream-sync-engine-debts/report.md

subject: aria-patterns
text: - **ARIA `role` attribute** — `role_from_name` maps ARIA role names (alert, button, checkbox, dialog, link, tab, textbox, landmark roles, etc.) to AccessKit roles (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:357-420)

subject: aria-patterns
text: - **ARIA state attributes** — `aria-selected` → `selected`, `aria-pressed` → `toggled` (a toggle button; `mixed` kept as Mixed), `aria-invalid` → `invalid` (True / Grammar / Spelling; a value outside the list reads True), read by value on any element — a select's option excepted, its `selected` its chosen state (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:184-194) — since 2026-10-10-snapshot-states; `aria-checked` → `toggled` (`true` · `false` · `mixed`) on a `CheckBox` · `Switch` · `RadioButton` · `MenuItemCheckBox` · `MenuItemRadio` role alone, `aria-pressed` read on every other role, a native checkbox or radio reading neither and, on a checkable role alone, writing `toggled` true or false from its own checked state, nothing under any other role (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:199-224), and `role="switch"` mapping to `Switch` (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) — `accessibility_states`' fourth test its pin (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:182-236; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_states.rs:141-158; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_states.rs:160-178; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_states.rs:180-199; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_states.rs:252-444; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:422-442) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-snapshot-states/report.md

subject: aria-patterns
text: - **Link** — `<a>` is a Link only with `href`, else GenericContainer (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:502-519; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_roles.rs:117-126)

subject: aria-patterns
text: - **Select** — `<select multiple>` is ListBox, else ComboBox (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:502-519; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_roles.rs:128-155)

subject: aria-patterns
text: - **Option group** — `optgroup` → `Role::Group`, its non-empty `label` attribute its name; a group's label is named in the tree and unpainted (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs) — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/report.md

subject: aria-patterns
text: - **Lists and tables** — ul/ol→List, li→ListItem, table→Table, thead→RowGroup, tr→Row, th→ColumnHeader, th scope=row→RowHeader, td→Cell (tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_roles.rs:95-115); `<th>` is RowHeader for `scope=row|rowgroup`, else ColumnHeader (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:502-519)

subject: aria-patterns
text: - **Form input** — `<input>` roles are mapped by `type`, defaulting to TextInput (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:537-555); label→Label, textarea→MultilineTextInput, progress→ProgressIndicator, meter→Meter, radio→RadioButton, range→Slider, email→EmailInput, password→PasswordInput (tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_roles.rs:128-155); text→TextInput, number→NumberInput, checkbox→CheckBox (tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_roles.rs:157-180)

subject: aria-patterns
text: - **Hidden content** — `aria-hidden="true"` keeps the node but marks it hidden (`is_hidden`); `hidden`, `display: none` and `visibility: hidden` exclude it — an `option` of a `select`, its child or under its `optgroup` (`is_select_option`), excepted from `display: none`, which every option of a single-choice select but its chosen one computes and a `multiple` select's rows do not: it stays in the tree, `hidden`, `inert` and `visibility: hidden` still excluding it (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:284-285; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:287-300); children of a hidden element are excluded (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:178-181; tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_hidden.rs:28-137)
